items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: We had Jacob Patrick, trombone. One of the Syncopated Orchestra. And myself on trumpet.

ctx.x: As a showman on the stage or to do a concert, to do tricks, to make people laugh, he was wonderful for that. But not to play tempo in a dance hall.
We had trombone. We had Jacob Patrick, trombone. One of the Syncopated Orchestra. And myself on trumpet.
But you couldn't do everything yourself, you see.
